seats.done_means: Done means all eleven units are terminal, plus one live proof that no AC carries. (1) Rowan's card exists: two Primaries, each with its own Interface row; validate personas is clean; an unnamed mint still names Maya; the PRD names Rowan with no outcome (US1079 AC1-AC4). This is the precondition for every Rowan End goal (D0379). (2) Both product seat cards approve a declared Secondary's End goal and judge a unit against the Primary of its interface, and a single-Primary cast reads as before (BG1066 AC1-AC3). This serves Jonah End goal 3 and O8, and it is the lens Rowan's units are reviewed under. (3) With sdlc.gateHost set, a push sends exactly the pushed commit with the remotes and tags refs; the host computes the same range and tag; a tag runs --boundary release there; a transport failure refuses and names SDLC_GATE_LOCAL=1; and the gate runs locally only when the configuration says so (US1075 AC1-AC5). Host runs get their own trees and run one at a time, a waiting run says so, and an abandoned push leaves nothing running (US1076 AC1-AC3). doctor names a missing prerequisite from the one list, and enable-hooks prints the host and its verdict (US1077 AC1-AC3). Together these serve Rowan End goal 1: a push judged against exactly the commit pushed, in minutes the work can absorb. (4) run-suite.sh all judges the hashed tree on the host, unstaged edits included, and --check reads that verdict (US1078 AC1-AC4). This serves Rowan End goal 4: main never left red. (5) The weekly corpus-verify job installs pytest-xdist and pdftotext, US0985 AC2 reads the cut's committed record, the ceiling clears US0940 AC1, and a dispatched run reports at the baseline with no NEW entry (BG1054 AC1-AC5). This serves Rowan End goal 4 and O4. (6) A lessons log written by retro.py extract passes markdownlint defaults (BG1061 AC1). This serves Maya End goal 3 and O3: a close commits without a bypass. (7) The TRD and TSD name every hook in git's order, each boundary, the three manual pre-tag steps, every .local path gate.py writes, every declared dependency, every CI job with its trigger, every lint check without a count, the CI Python floor, every gate-host setting, the three places the gate can run, and the transport refusal, each derived from its source file (US1084 AC1-AC4, US1085 AC1-AC4, US1086 AC1-AC2). This serves O4 and Rowan End goal 3 (a release a consuming team can upgrade to, D0375). (8) Needed for the headline but carried by no AC: this clone's sdlc.gateHost is set (it is unset today), and one real push from this clone is judged on devserver1 without --no-verify, which retires D0370's interim rule. This serves Rowan End goal 1.

Host runs are serialised and an abandoned push leaves nothing running (US1076 AC1-AC3). doctor names a missing prerequisite in seconds (US1077 AC1-AC3). run-suite.sh runs the full suite on the host and --check reads that verdict (US1078 AC1-AC4). Persona-level check, which no AC holds: at least one of the run's own pushes is recorded under boundary-push@<host> in gate-timings, with its duration beside D0366's 634-636 s. (3) ROWAN EG1 and EG3. The TRD and TSD name, each read from its own source: every hook in run order, each boundary, the three manual pre-tag steps (D0375) and the gate's .local writes (US1084 AC1-AC4); every declared dependency, each CI job with its trigger, the lint checks uncounted and the 3.10 floor (US1085 AC1-AC4); every gate-host setting and the three gate locations (US1086 AC1-AC2). (4) ROWAN EG4. A dispatched Lint run's corpus-verify job reports red criteria at the baseline with no NEW entry (BG1054 AC1-AC5). (5) MAYA EG3 / O3, shipped, so judged against Maya. A lessons log written by retro.py extract passes markdownlint's defaults, so a close commits without a bypass (BG1061 AC1). This serves a real goal, but no clause of the Sprint Goal names it. Verdict: clauses 2-4 serve real persona goals. Clause 1 serves the machinery, justified by D0379 and D0380. Clause 5 serves Maya, outside the goal's wording.

seats.done_means: Serves Rowan's End goal 1 (a push is judged against exactly the commit pushed, in minutes the work can absorb) and End goal 4 (main never left red and unread) through EP0288, and PRD O4, with O1 for BG1054, through EP0290 and BG1054. The plan-time trace reads NONE because the card does not exist yet. After US1079 lands, re-run the trace with --serves naming Rowan (D0380). Clause by clause: (1) 'judged on a gate host', as a mechanism, is proven executably over a stubbed transport. US1075 AC1-AC5: the exact pushed commit is sent with refs mirrored, push and release boundaries are honoured, a transport exit 255 refuses and names SDLC_GATE_LOCAL=1. US1076 AC1-AC3: a tree per run, a host lock, nothing left behind after INT/TERM or a dropped transport. US1077 AC1-AC3: doctor checks the one prerequisite list and enable-hooks names the host. US1078 AC1-AC4: the hashed tree runs on the host and --check reads its verdict. (2) 'Rowan's push' on a 'configured' host has no executable proof. Every one of these tests uses a stub or fixture home. This clone has no sdlc.gateHost set today, and gate-timings holds only the local boundary-push series. Done should mean: sdlc.gateHost names devserver1, remote-gate.sh doctor exits 0 against it, and at least one of the run's own pushes after US1075 is judged there with no --no-verify, shown by a boundary-push@devserver1 row in gate-timings. 'In minutes' has no AC; the timing record is only a US1075 Note. (3) 'The gate's documents tell the truth' is proven for the TRD and TSD by tests derived from the source files. US1084 AC1-AC4: hooks in git's order, each --boundary, the three manual pre-tag steps, the .local writes. US1085 AC1-AC4: dependencies, CI jobs with their triggers, the uncounted lint chain, the Python floor. US1086 AC1-AC2: gate-host settings and the three gate locations. No criterion covers the gate-host prose that US1075 and US1077 add to CONTRIBUTING.md or that US1078 adds to AGENTS.md [LC-018]. (4) 'The weekly run tells the truth': BG1054 AC1-AC4 only read lint.yml and the US0985 verifier, so they show the job is configured, not that it reports truly. The clause rests wholly on the manual AC5. Done should mean a dispatched Lint run (or the 2026-10-26 scheduled one) whose corpus-verify job prints red-criteria: 0 with no NEW entry, against the baseline of 0, with the run id recorded on BG1054 before Fixed. (5) US1079 AC1-AC4 and BG1066 AC1-AC3 prove the card and the seat-card text. They are preconditions for 'Rowan' and for the reviews, not proof of any clause. BG1061 AC1 proves no clause.
seats.note: One increment because 8 of the 11 units deliver the goal's three clauses about one subject: where the gate runs, what its documents say, what its weekly lane reports. US1079 and BG1066 are preconditions under D0380. BG1061 (2 of 31 points) is the one rider and serves no clause. Risks: (a) BG1054 AC5 is manual and alone carries 'the weekly run'. transition -> Fixed does not refuse an unrun manual criterion. The corpus run also re-executes this batch's own new Done criteria in an environment with no gate host. Make AC5 an executable read of the run's red-criteria line, as the pre-push red-main read already does with gh, or require the run id before Fixed. (b) BG1054 AC4's headroom rests on a 276 s developer-machine figure against a 300 s ceiling. tools/verify-corpus-baseline.txt itself rules a local reading inadmissible (BG0676), and ubuntu-latest is slower. (c) BG1054 AC3 is an either/or that a retirement satisfies. known_issues.py bar survives, so re-point the verifier, never retire it [LC-015]. (d) US1075: no AC fails if the configured-host path skips D0181's red-main read or US1005's preflight. Both are Notes only, and test_pre_push_hook.py's red-main tests run with no host. (e) US1076 AC2 and AC3 are lock and signal tests that will run on a host shared with a CI runner (load 10.6, BG1031; ModuleAloneLaneTests at its 3.0 s bound). They must synchronise on events, not wall clock. (f) US1084 AC3/AC4, US1085 AC2 and US1086 AC1 derive their sets from source. Each must assert a known member (sdlc.gateHost, SDLC_GATE_LOCAL, release_cut.py tag-check, gate-suite-verdict.json), or an empty derivation passes vacuously (LL0043). gate-timings.json is written by tools/gate_timing.py, so a grep of gate.py alone is a lower bound; tools/repo_writes.py lists the writes. (g) US1085 AC4 assumes one 'floor job', but ci and corpus-verify both install 3.10 and 3.12; the test must name the job it reads. (h) BG1061 AC1 claims markdownlint's default rules, but its selector names only MD026, and no AC pins that existing headings do not churn. (i) US1078 touches the shipped reference-sprint-toolchain.md, so under US1079 AC4 and BG1066 AC2 it is judged against Maya. D0380 still repoints it to Rowan. The consult raised this and it is unresolved; settle it before its review. (j) D0370 lapses when US1075 ships. With sdlc.gateHost unset, pushes fall back to a local gate this workstation cannot hold. (k) The D0380 persona repoints are main-tree paperwork; commit them only between builds [LC-014]. (l) BG1066's routing by interface is text a reviewer reads. critic.py brief does not carry the unit's persona card, and nothing executes the routing before US1080.
